release_read.basis: Q3 product net sales $1,721M (+13% QoQ, +$205M add) beat the disputed $1.57-1.65B aggregator bar by about 4-10%, and diluted EPS $7.80 beat Nasdaq's $7.44 despite ~$150M of Forte costs; the last two beats on this line were bought +5.8% and +8.6%, shrunk for the +8% rebound into the print and the raised-looking $4B opex line.

release.headline: argenx reports third quarter 2026 financial results: global product net sales $1.7B, +54% YoY, +13% QoQ

vs_bar.consensus_source: https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/x/ARGX (EarningsWhispers total revenue bar as read by the hunt 2026-10-21; disputed, an older figure was $1.57B)
Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback, 7 estimates)

key_line.detail: $1,721M against $1,516M in Q2 (+$205M sequential add, in line with the hunt's $1.72-1.77B extrapolation, at its low end); regional split not in the release.

guidance.detail: No revenue guidance. Combined R&D + SG&A now expected at about $4B for 2026 including Forte transaction costs; prior-guide comparison not verified in time.

call.detail: Call at 14:30 CET / 08:30 ET, so it was under way or finished before the open; content not read in time. The pre-market weakness after the call may reflect call content (opex, gMG growth commentary) that was not verified.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions found this morning in the time available. A Stockopedia item ('argenx tops BEL 20 after Q3 beat', +7.5%) could not be dated and its figures do not match this release, so it is treated as an older article and ignored.

tape_read.vs_implied_move: beyond (against a 3.29% median historical reaction, opposite sign)
tape_read.note: Robust reference 859.50 (-3.43%) against prev close 890.05; last print 869.45 at 09:04 (-2.31%), range 854.04-869.45; 12 prints, 3 in the last 30 min, not stale. Market is down (SPY -0.94%, QQQ -0.71%), explaining about a point. Euronext Brussels has traded since 03:00 ET, so the price has had a home-market session to form. The release read says +4%; the tape says -3.4%: either the call or the opex line is being sold, or the 8% run-up is being sold on a beat that landed at the low end of the whisper range.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was a sales beat on the sequential-add pattern; $1,721M is a beat against the aggregator bar but at the low end of the hunt's $1.72-1.77B range, which a whisper set by the run-up may have exceeded.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market is active and the stock has a Brussels session behind it, so the open should hold most of the -3.4%; a gap against a clean revenue and EPS beat, partly macro, tends to give part back in the first half hour.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn beter dan verwacht (omzet $1,72 mld, winst per aandeel $7,80), maar het aandeel staat voorbeurs ruim 3% lager, deels door een zwakke markt. De positie verliest nu; zo'n daling tegen goede cijfers in herstelt vaak een deel in het eerste halfuur, dus verkoop om 10:00 in plaats van bij de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als het aandeel voor 09:30 verder wegzakt richting $850 of als er een negatieve analistenreactie of slecht nieuws uit de call verschijnt, dan direct bij de opening verkopen.
